title: Sagebrush board
description: A board: one page (its own `nodes`, `edges` and `steps`), or several (`pages`). Written from web/board/doc.ts by scripts/board-format-schema.mjs; the format is described at https://sagebrush.space/board-format.md.

mode.description: the language of its code items, one per board (default `python`)

engine.description: `"latest"`, in a downloaded file: run with the newest engine when online (written by Sagebrush)

seed.description: 64 hex digits: the seed of its code's random numbers; without it a fixed default is used, so a board's random numbers are always repeatable

tools.description: the toolbar's tools in Edit mode, in order (written by Sagebrush)

images.description: pictures by name: `{w, h, src}` (pixels; `src` a `data:` or `https:` URL). A name is letters, digits, `_` and `-`, at most 100 characters (`plot-1`, not `plot 1` or `figure.png`): a picture by another name is left out, and so is a note's or a background's use of it

pages.description: several pages; a document with pages has no `nodes`, `edges` or `steps` of its own

intro.description: Markdown shown before the tour starts (with pages: on the first page, if it has no `intro` of its own)

refBase.description: the base URL for `ref` links that are paths (e.g. a repository's blob URL)

layout.description: how the top-level items are laid out (default `graph`)

nodes.description: the items of a one-page board

anyOf.description: several: `pages`, each with its own `nodes`, and no `nodes`, `edges` or `steps` of the document's own

BoardPage.description: A page of a board: its own items, edges and tour.

id.description: needed by templates; unique among the pages

intro.description: Markdown shown before the page's tour (without it, the page's title is shown; on the first page, the document's `intro`)

layout.description: how the page's items are laid out (default `graph`)

slide.description: the card the page is arranged on, a slide, which Present shows

template.description: `true`: other pages can be made from it (it needs an `id`)

uses.description: a template page's id: its card, background and items appear under this page's own

DocNote.description: A note: the default item. Every part is optional; a note with `code` is a code item.

id.description: required: unique on its page (an edge names it)

image.description: a picture: its name in the document's `images` (letters, digits, `_` and `-`, at most 100 characters)

text.description: Markdown with math (`$...$`), shown at every zoom

code.description: code in the board's language (`mode`), run in the reader's browser, its output under it; it makes the note a code item

hideCode.description: `true`: show only the code's output, not the code

mode.description: a code item's language, when it is not the board's (`"python"`, `"sage"`, `"magma"` or `"matlab"`; default: the board's `mode`). Each language runs in its own interpreter: languages share no values, so copy data from one to another as literals

preview.description: a slow code item's output, kept to show before it runs (written by Sagebrush)

detail.description: Markdown shown only when zoomed in

ref.description: a link: a URL, a paper, or a path (`src/file.py#L10`) resolved against `refBase`; or a place on the board: `#p2` (page 2), `#p2-3` (its step 3), `#3` (this page's step 3), `#id` (the page with that id, or the item), `#page-id/item-id` (an item on a page); in Markdown text too, as `[see Boards](#boards)`

color.description: a color (`#e8f0fb`, a CSS color name, `rgb(...)`, `hsl(...)`)

shape.description: its outline (a flowchart's); its text is then centered. `diamond` (a decision) is pointed at its left and right and flat at its top and bottom, so that its text fits a note's width, not a true rhombus (which would need twice its text's width and height); `hexagon` is the same, less pointed

fit.description: `true`: as wide as its text needs, up to `w`

x.description: its position, kept once a person moves it: leave it out, and the board places it

w.description: its width (default 260; 440 for a code item; for a note with only a picture, the picture's width, up to 480, its height then from the picture's shape)

h.description: its height (default: as tall as what it shows)

DocGroup.description: A group: items laid out together, under a title. Groups nest; an edge may join any two items on a page, in any groups.

text.description: Markdown with math, under the title

layout.description: how its items are laid out (default `graph`: in layers along the edges among them)

columns.description: `grid` layout: how many columns (default: as square as can be)

direction.description: `graph` layout: layers top to bottom (`TB`, the default) or left to right (`LR`)

x.description: its position, kept once a person moves it: leave it out

w.description: its width at least, as a person made it by its corner (it is as wide as this, or as its items need, whichever is more)

DocInk.description: A pen stroke, drawn by a person. Don't write these.

points.description: required: x, y and pressure (0 to 1) of each point, from the corner (`x`, `y`)

opacity.description: below 1: a highlighter's, which what is under it shows through

x.description: required: the corner of its box

DocSticker.description: A sticker: one emoji, or one of CoCalc's icons, shown without a frame. It needs `emoji` or `icon`.

icon.description: one of CoCalc's icons, by name (a converted CoCalc board), with `color`

x.description: its position: leave it out, and the board places it

DocAsk.description: A question for the person reading the board: checkboxes, radio buttons, a list to choose from, a text, a number or a scale. Its answer is kept in it, as `answer`: given on the board with its controls, or written by a host's submission or `sagebrush board answers --apply`.

id.description: required: unique on its page (an answer names it)

input.description: required: how it is answered: `check` (any of `options`, or without them one yes/no box), `radio` (one of `options`), `choice` (one of `options`, from a list: for many), `text`, `number` or `scale` (a whole number from `min` to `max`)

options.description: `check`, `radio` and `choice`: what may be chosen; each a text, or `{ "value": ..., "label": ... }` to keep its answers when its words change

required.description: `true`: it must be answered before the answers are sent

min.description: `number`: the least it takes; `scale`: its first value (default 1)

max.description: `number`: the most it takes; `scale`: its last value (default 5)

step.description: `number`: the step between the values it takes

low.description: `scale`: the words at its low end ("disagree")

high.description: `scale`: the words at its high end ("agree")

lines.description: `text`: how many lines its field shows (default 1)

note.description: the reader's answer in their own words (plain text, English or any language): beside the answer, or in place of it. A question with a note that is not only spaces counts as answered

answer.description: the answer given: for `check` the values chosen (a list; `true` or `false` without options), for `radio` and `choice` the value chosen, for `text` a string, for `number` and `scale` a number

check.description: code in the board's language that decides whether an answer is right (Python and Sage boards): the answer is bound to `answer`, in a scope of its own (a copy of the board's names); the value of its last expression is the verdict: `True` (right), `False` (wrong), or a string (wrong, and the string, Markdown with math, is shown). Run when the reader presses Check, within `checkMs`

checkMs.description: the most milliseconds its check, or a computed hint, may run (a whole number, 1 to 10000; default 2000)

hints.description: hints, one more shown after each wrong attempt: Markdown, or `{ "code": ... }`, run as the check is, its value a string (Markdown)

next.description: where to go after an attempt: the id of a note on this page, for `right` and for `wrong`

decide.description: what the reader's own words (`note`) may show, for the host to decide among (at most 32): each a self-describing name, such as a misconception, and where to go if it is the one (web/board-host-protocol.md, "Deciding")

example.description: an answer to try its check with (`sagebrush board try` runs it)

attempts.description: how many times its answer was checked (written by Sagebrush)

wrongAttempts.description: how many of those were wrong: one more hint is shown after each (written by Sagebrush)

result.description: the last check's verdict: `right`, `wrong` or `error` (written by Sagebrush)

detail.description: Markdown shown only when zoomed in

x.description: its position: leave it out, and the board places it

h.description: its height (default: as tall as what it shows)

AskChoice.description: One of a question's options, whose `value` its answer names: its `label` (default: the value) is what the reader sees.

value.description: required: what an answer says when this is chosen

label.description: what the reader sees (Markdown with math; default: `value`)

AskHintCode.description: A hint computed from the reader's answer.

code.description: required: code run as the question's check is, `answer` bound; its value, a string, is the hint (Markdown)

AskNext.description: Where a question leads after an attempt: notes on its page, by id.

right.description: the note to go to after a right answer

wrong.description: the note to go to after a wrong one

AskDecide.description: One of the things a reader's own words may show, which the host decides among.

name.description: required: what it is, in words joined by hyphens, at least three (`confuses-transitive-with-2-transitive`): the name says what it means

about.description: Markdown that makes the name clearer (a rubric), if it needs that

next.description: the id of an item on this page to go to when it is the one

DocEdge.description: An edge between two items on a page, drawn as an arrow from `from` to `to`.

hidden.description: `true`: not drawn, only used to lay out (to place one box below another)

arrow.description: arrowheads: at the end (when left out), `none`, or `both` ends

DocStep.description: A step of a tour: the camera shows these items while the caption explains them.

focus.description: required: an item's id, or several

SlideRect.description: A slide's card on its page, in board coordinates.

color.description: a color: on a slide's card, or behind the whole board

image.description: a picture's name in `images` (letters, digits, `_` and `-`, at most 100 characters), on a slide's card

ImageInfo.description: A picture a note shows, by its name in the document's `images`.

anyOf.description: a data: URL of a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP picture (base64)

src.description: its bytes, which a file needs to show the picture: a `data:` URL (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP), or an `https:` address

DocNode.description: An item: a note, a group, ink, a sticker or a question, as its `kind` says (a note's `kind` is `"note"`, or left out).
